features.title: Implement the transfer of an item between players. The user's words, translated: «implement the item transfer». The backend has it: an item entry has `kind` (`catalog | user_item | user_item_transfer`, items.yaml and perks.yaml of https://api.fgg-challenge.com/scalar; there is no `userItem` flag any more). For `user_item_transfer` the amount is positive and counts the copies moved for each chosen user, `target` is the side that loses the copies (`self` gives to the chosen users, `chosen` hand to the holder), `targetLogins` of the use are required and none is the holder, `userItemIds` hold the copies of the losing side in the order of the entries and, inside an entry, of `targetLogins`. The history event is `item_transferred`: `login` lost the copy, `receiverLogin` received it. The client keeps the kind in `ItemEntryRow.kind` (`user-item-transfer`), reads and writes it in api-facade/http/rows.ts and changeEntry.ts, reads the event in api-facade/http/journal.ts, builds the slots in utils/itemUse.ts useSlots, shows them in views/Resources/components/UseDialog.vue and sets the entry in components/RowsEditor.vue (the item-entry variant of the catalogue and perk ability forms, utils/formRows.ts). Decisions: the copy that is being used stays excluded from every slot, a transfer row has the fixed action «Передаёт» and a positive amount, the targets of a transfer never include the holder. The target conditions of an item (`target_*`) are still allowed only with an entry that has `who: chosen` (CatalogEntryDialog.vue); check this against the documentation for a transfer to `self`.
features.evidence: Done 2026-11-12. Checked by the user (said in chat: «Всё работает»). Run: bash harness/scripts/init.sh passes, prettier on the changed files; useSlots, needsTargets, needsUseForm and allowedTargets were run in Node for a giving and a taking transfer; the contract was compared with items.yaml, perks.yaml and history.yaml. The direction of a transfer is set by the entry in the catalogue («Владелец» gives to the chosen players, «Цель» hands to the owner), not chosen at the use. Left open: a target_* condition with a transfer to the holder is still refused by the catalogue form.
